_note: Links to the Punjab boards' own published copies, never copies of ours, the same rule as data/fbise/papers.json. Some boards post their files on Google Drive from their official pages; those are the board's own uploads.
Every url answered with a real PDF or image on the retrieved date. Sargodha links open the board's own page viewer.
Several boards host the same PECTAA model paper; one copy per class, subject and year is kept.

Left out: Sahiwal's papers exist only as ZIP/RAR archives of 83 MB to 1.38 GB, which a browser cannot open a page of; Multan's 2019 to 2024 Drive files are blocked by Google; DG Khan publishes nothing.
No Punjab board publishes topper answer scripts. BISE Lahore notice 63-CE/P (March 2025) bars sharing old papers in social media groups; linking to the boards' own files is not that.
